documents.title: Rail Marshal's Journal
documents.found: On the dead marshal, at the wreck
documents.text:
Greenwater. Ostrander took ill on the 9th. By the 14th he was gone. I carried the line's word to the yard the same week. Last I saw, no one had been sent in his place.

Odd, then, that every car I rode on this trip came up on the list as 'signed clean'.

Pritchard will want to see this in person.
